tiers.name: Pay what you want
tiers.description: Entirely optional. If FirstTake saved a shoot, chip in any amount ($1 minimum) to support development. It unlocks nothing; everything is already free.

storefront.summary: Built by working film professionals and already used by dozens of them on hundreds of hours of footage. For anyone making content — casual YouTubers, freelance shooters, and studios alike. Takes a shoot with no shared timecode through conform, edit, grade, mix, captions, and delivery, with every number measured, not guessed.
storefront.requirements_plain: A Mac or Windows computer and an AI coding assistant: Claude Code (terminal, desktop app, web, or VS Code / JetBrains) or another coding agent. Setup installs everything else it needs, after asking, and nothing it doesn't. No editing software required: it renders a full-quality master itself; DaVinci Resolve Studio or Adobe Premiere Pro (early access) is optional, only for an editable timeline.
storefront.footage_privacy: Runs entirely on the user's own computer and never sends footage, or any details about a shoot, to anyone. (What the user types to their AI assistant is covered by that assistant's own privacy terms.)
storefront.track_record: Before its public release, already in daily use by dozens of working professionals across documentary, scripted content, interviews, and social shorts, with hundreds of hours of footage put through it.
use_cases: Documentary: verified card offload and footage QC for material that can't be reshot.
Interviews: multi-camera sync with no shared timecode, per-speaker audio, word-level speaker attribution.
Scripted content: run sheets, call order, and a timeline built from one plan — rendered with ffmpeg, or as an editable Resolve or Premiere timeline.
Social shorts and YouTube: vertical cuts with burned-in captions and pull clips from the same master.
storefront.updates: Actively developed by working film professionals; new capabilities ship regularly (finishing with no editing software at all is the latest). Every update is free: pull the latest from GitHub.
storefront.install: Download or clone https://github.com/emersonsklar/firsttake, open the folder in Claude Code (or another AI coding assistant) and say "set this up for me" — it follows SETUP-FOR-CLAUDE.md, asks before installing anything, and finishes with a one-minute practice run. By hand: git clone https://github.com/emersonsklar/firsttake ~/.claude/skills/firsttake, then python3 scripts/doctor.py.
storefront.contributing: Contributions are welcome: issues and pull requests on GitHub, especially quiet failures from real shoots and gear it doesn't handle yet. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
storefront.feedback: Feature requests and workflow needs are welcome as GitHub issues or at support@sklarstad.com — every request is read and directly shapes what gets built next.
